$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (a trigger, or the bar) and how to read it.

root.$why: The bar's 1 px border is an inset shadow (Figma draws it inside). The bar's width is the sum of its triggers', which follow their labels' glyph widths; Figma rounds each trigger to whole pixels (68 + 53 + 69), so the bar is checked by its height, padding, radius and stroke.

Label.$why: The renderer marks the (first) trigger's label.
